messages:
arjun: Quick sync — we need a compact sprint-gate checklist for retention/BYOK/SOC2 work. Goal: unambiguous sign-off criteria so PM/legal/eng can close the gate.

mona: +1. My proposal: minimal acceptance items (schema, BYOK handshake, retention mapping, evidence export runbook). Keep it tight.

carmen: Can we make the BYOK item explicit: KMS rotation tests, export/restore with escrow, and a failed-handoff rollback doc. Ops needs a playbook.

arjun: Sketch below — short and testable. Feedback welcome.

```
- audit_event_schema: v1.2 (backwards-compatible)
- retention_buckets: hot=30d, warm=365d, cold=3650d
- byok_flow: handshake + export + restore validated on 2 tenants
- kms_rotation: automated rotate + manual-escrow path tested
- soc2_evidence: 3 exported evidence packs + retrieval test
- telemetry: add tag audit_export_v1 on all export runs
- rollout: canary -> regional -> global with fallback plan
```

mona: That looks actionable. Two clarifications: (1) RTO/RPO expectations per bucket? (2) legal needs explicit contract language for retention extensions.

legal-rep: For contract: require customer notification for >90d retention beyond baseline, and a clear escrow acceptance signoff. Also want export proof (hash + signed manifest) in evidence pack.

arjun: Agreed. For RTO/RPO: hot=minutes RTO, warm=hours RTO, cold=days RTO. I'll put numbers in the doc. Decision suggestion: hot=15m RTO, warm=4h, cold=48h.

carmen: Eng will own schema + export tool + restore tests. Ops owns KMS rotation automation and manual escrow runbook. Legal owns contract text. PM (mona) to own the acceptance doc and the stakeholder sign-off.

mona: Action items: @carmen create 2d spike to harden export + restore tests; @arjun add smoke test and telemetry tag; @legal-rep draft contract snippet for notification/manifest; ops to validate rotation runbook.

arjun: I'll add a smoke test curl example to validate export endpoint: 

```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-123","start":"2024-02-01","end":"2024-02-07","format":"ndjson"}'
```

dev-ops-bot: Note: retention bucket changes require a small DB migration and metadata backfill — schedule a short maintenance window during canary. Also link: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/retention-migration>.

carmen: Also flag cross-region backups — retention values must be enforced consistently. Ticketing note added.

mona: Final ask before I publish acceptance doc: confirm 3 tenants for export/restore test (dev, staging, one customer sandbox). If all green, I'll sign off and mark sprint gate ready. :white_check_mark:

arjun: I'll wire up telemetry and schedule tests today. Will post results here once smoke runs complete.

mona: Thanks — once tests pass I'll tag stakeholders and move to sign-off.
